quote: 22 flags total. REQUIRED: --artifact --contract --performative --objective. Defaults from contract: kind=artifacts[0].kind, token-budget=context_delta.token_budget_max||4000, trust-level=trust_level||standard. Env: ECL_HOST, ECL_MODEL, ECL_HMAC_KEY.
yq (mikefarah Go OR python-yq), else python3 -c 'import yaml'. Three forms attempted: 'yq eval . -o=json', 'yq -o=json .', 'yq .'.
new_uuid(): uuidgen | tr A-Z a-z, else od -x /dev/urandom + awk formatting. Not UUIDv7. THREAD_ID defaults to MESSAGE_ID for first envelope of thread.

SIZE_BYTES=wc -c. sha256: shasum -a 256 OR sha256sum, awk '{print $1}'. hmac-sha256: openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$ECL_HMAC_KEY". Computed over raw artefact bytes, no canonicalization. Exit 2 on shasum unavailable.
Single jq -n call with --arg/--argjson for every field. artifact.sha256 and integrity.value both set to $INTEGRITY_VALUE; same digest.
SDK_DIR/.. /.. resolves repo root; exec bash "$CHECK" "$ENVELOPE" $CONTRACTS_FLAG $JSON_FLAG. No local validation logic in the helper.
Writes <artifact>.envelope.json with printf > (overwrite). Appends one jq -nc JSONL line to .eidolons/.trace/<thread_id>.jsonl with >>. mkdir -p TRACE_DIR unconditional. No flock, no mv -n atomicity.
Errors if TRACE_DIR missing. Builds JQ_FILTER with select(.from|startswith("$FROM@")) and same for to. follow: tail -F into jq -c. otherwise cat into jq -c.
# Optional: ajv-cli or python -m jsonschema for full JSON Schema validation (falls back to structural field checks via jq). [In practice only the jq path is implemented.]

. lib/envelope.sh; . lib/integrity.sh; . lib/handoff-graph.sh; . lib/context-budget.sh. Each envelope passes through ecl_check_envelope, ecl_check_integrity, ecl_check_handoff_graph (w/ CONTRACTS_DIR), ecl_check_context_budget.

E-1 jq empty (valid JSON); E-2 required fields (envelope_version, message_id, thread_id, parent_id, from, to, performative, objective, artifact, integrity, trace); E-3 version regex 1.0|1.0.*; E-4 performative in 10-enum; E-5 from/to.eidolon regex ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ OR human/orchestrator; E-6 artifact.path not absolute, no '..'; E-7 SHOULD edge_origin populated; E-8 trace.tier standard|trance.

I-1 value matches ^[0-9a-f]{64}$. I-2 payload resolvable: tries env_dir/basename(apath), then apath, then env_dir/apath. I-3 recompute sha256 or hmac-sha256 (warn if HMAC and ECL_HMAC_KEY unset). I-4 SHOULD size_bytes matches wc -c.

C-1 find contract by from+to scanning $contracts_dir/*.yaml. C-2 performative in contract.performatives_allowed. C-3 artifact.kind in [contract.artifacts[].kind]. C-4 SHOULD envelope.edge_origin matches contract.edge_origin.

D-0 SHOULD context_delta present. D-1 MUST tokens_used <= envelope.context_delta.token_budget. D-2 MUST tokens_used <= contract.context_delta.token_budget_max. D-3 SHOULD summary length chars/4 <= 200.

patternProperties ^x_[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$ for vendor ext fields; additionalProperties:false otherwise. agentRef has required [eidolon, version], pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ for slug, version pattern ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$ OR ^n/a$.

artifacts[].fields: kind (slug), schema_ref (string path), required_sections (string[]), evidence_anchor_required (bool, default false). context_delta: token_budget_max (int>=0), required_handles[]. trust_level enum low|standard|high. allOf+if/then: edge_origin=implicit requires notes.

required [ts, event, message_id, thread_id, from, to, performative, integrity_method]. event enum [emit, receive, verify_pass, verify_fail]. from/to pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*@(\d+\.\d+\.\d+|n/a)$. verify_failure_code required when event=verify_fail (7 codes).
required [eidolon, version, kind, status, created_at]. Pattern slug for eidolon; SemVer for version; UUID for thread_id (optional). additionalProperties:true (children allOf-extend it).
